Name: Regional Banking and Taxes System (RBTS) - Immersive and configurable mod
Author: losgar38
Description:
[b][center][img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2026/04/6/1769279250-title-2.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]                                                                                                             ﻿
[/b]
Why this mod exists ? Several banking mods already exist for Stardew Valley, but most of them are either [b]very old[/b], [b]abandoned[/b], or [b]too limited[/b] compared to what I personally wanted.
I was looking for a system that felt:
[list]
[*]immersive
[*]consistent with long-term progression
[*]configurable
[*]and integrated naturally into the game
[/list]Since I couldn’t find exactly what I had in mind, I decided to build it myself.
This mod is the result of that idea:
a [b]modern, stable, and fully integrated banking and taxation system[/b] designed to feel like a natural extension of Stardew Valley.

[quote]⚠️ [b]Note[/b]: English is not my first language.
Please excuse any mistakes in wording or grammar. Also, im a begginer in code/modding so, expect bug or weird thing at first x')[/quote][line]
[b][size=3][center]Overview[/center]

[/size]Regional Banking & Taxes System[/b] adds a complete financial layer to the game, including:
[list]
[*]Regional banks (Joja or Cooperative)
[*]Real bank accounts with balances
[*]Seasonal interest based on average savings
[*]Automatic deposit system
[*]Seasonal taxes with debt mechanics
[*]In-game menus, letters, and items
[*]Full i18n support (EN / FR)
[*]
[/list]The mod is designed to be:
✔ immersive
✔ configurable
✔ safe for existing saves
✔ stable for long-term play

[line]
[b][size=4][center]Main Features[/center][/size]
﻿[/b][b][size=2][left]Banking System[/left][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Open a bank account via an in-game brochure
[*]Choose between [b]Joja Bank[/b] or [b]Cooperative Bank[/b]
[*]Deposit and withdraw gold
[*]Close your account at any time (with consequences)
[*]Clean, responsive in-game UI
[/list] [b]Seasonal Interest

[/b][list]
[*]Interest paid [b]once per season (Day 1)[/b]
[*]Based on [b]average balance[/b], not exploitable end-of-season values
[*]Different rates per bank
[*]Optional caps and requirements
[*]Fully configurable via GMCM
[/list][b] Automatic Deposits

[/b][list]
[*]Automatically deposit a percentage of nightly shipping income
[*]Adjustable from [b]0% to 100%[/b]
[*]Can be toggled ON / OFF at any time
[*]Clear and predictable behavior
[/list][b]Taxes & Debt System

[/b][list]
[*]Seasonal taxes (income, capital, property)
[*]Tax bill delivered by mail
[*]Taxes can be paid:
[list]
[*]manually
[*]automatically overnight
[/list][*]Unpaid taxes become [b]debt[/b]
[*]Weekly penalties on unpaid debt
[*]Debt collection from shipping income
[*]Bank-specific consequences:
[*]
[/list][spoiler]Joja blacklist if not paid for x season.
[list]
[*]Cooperative debt forgiveness (under conditions)[/spoiler]
[/list][b][center][/center][/b][left][b]In-Game Letters & RP
[/b][/left][b]
[/b][list]
[*]Banking brochure delivered via mailbox at day 3 or next day during a game already started
[*]Tax letters with detailed breakdown
[*]Fully localized (EN / FR)
[*]No immersion-breaking popups
[/list][b] Configuration (GMCM)

[/b][list]
[*]Enable or disable:
[list]
[*]interest
[*]taxes
[*]tax categories
[/list][*]Adjust rates, caps, penalties
[*]Safe to use on existing saves
Also, there is a Key (k) to use the bank menu without the item.[b][size=4][center][/center][/size][/b] ﻿﻿[/list][b][center][size=3]Troubleshooting
[/size][/center][/b]For player with medium/small resolution, the first IU could (will ^^) be very crowded, im sitll looking for a way to make this better but didn't find it yet.
                                                             




   
[list]
[b] [size=5][center][u]Getting started[/u][/center][/size]

[/b]On a new save, you will receive a letter from Mayor Lewis on [b]Spring Year 1 – Day 3[/b].This letter introduces the regional banking system and provides a brochure item. (if you have already a save, it will be on the next morning after the first day you play with this mod).[b] Choosing a bank

[/b]Using the brochure allows you to open a bank account and choose between two institutions:[list]
[*][b]Joja Premium Bank[/b] (higher interest, stricter rules)
[*][b]Cooperative Market Bank[/b] (lower interest, more forgiving)
[/list][/list][list]
Once opened, you receive a bank card item used to access the banking menu. (or press K by defaut)[b] Banking features

[/b][list]
[*]Deposit and withdraw money at any time
[*]Optional automatic deposits from nightly shipping income
[*]Automatic deposits can be enabled, disabled, and adjusted in percentage
[/list][/list][list]
[b]
 Seasonal interest

[/b]Interest is paid on [b]Day 1 of each season[/b], based on your [b]average bank balance from the previous season[/b].[b]Taxes

[/b]Starting in [b]Summer Year 1[/b], taxes are billed on [b]Day 1 of each season[/b] and are based on:[list]
[*]Income (shipping profits)
[*]Capital (cash + bank balance)
[*]Property (house level and farm buildings)
[/list][/list][list]
Taxes can be paid manually during the day or automatically overnight.Unpaid taxes become debt and may trigger penalties.[b]Debt & consequences

[/b][list]
[*]Unpaid taxes become debt with weekly penalties
[/list][/list][spoiler]Joja Bank may blacklist you if debts remain unpaid[/spoiler]
[spoiler]The Cooperative Bank may forgive debt under specific conditions[/spoiler]

[list]
[b]Configuration (GMCM)

[/b]All major systems (interest, taxes, difficulty multipliers, debt behavior) are fully configurable through GMCM.[/list]

FAQ❓[/center][/size][/b]-Can I disable taxes ?
Yes. Taxes can be fully disabled via GMCM. Outstanding taxes can also be canceled if the option is enabled.

- Can I close my bank account?
Yes. Closing your account:
[list]
[*]transfers remaining bank balance back to you
[*]disables interest and auto-deposit
[*]keeps current tax obligations
[*]allows reopening later via a new brochure
[/list]-Is this mod balanced?
Default settings are intentionally conservative, but maybe need a better testing.
Anyway, the mod is designed to be [b]customizable[/b], not restrictive.

-Is multiplayer supported?
The mod is mainly designed for single-player. Multiplayer has not been tested.
Multiplayer has not been extensively tested.
Multiplayer has not been extensively tested.
